Definition: Jashub, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jashub is the name of two Israelites, a son of Issachar in the genealogy of the tribe, and a son of Bani who had taken a strange wife in the days of Ezra. One stands at the beginning of the tribe's story, the other at its return from exile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the name through the centuries, from Issachar's son to the return, and the record is honest about both.
RelatedPeople: Jashub, Son of Issachar; Jashub, Son of Bani
